## Notes

SCS Software, Prism3D; Windows 2012-10-18, Linux 2013, macOS 2015; timed deliveries with pay reduced by damage; fuel, tolls, repair costs; buy trucks, trailers, garages, hire AI drivers; skill points unlock ADR, fragile, urgent jobs; 71 cities in 12 countries; TruckersMP mod 2013, official multiplayer 2021; over 22 million sold by 2026.
